_doc: SPEC-98 rotation-aware distribution freshness thresholds. Any key here overrides the documented default in capabilities/rotation_freshness.py DEFAULT_CFG. fresh_window_h: tracked outflow within this = FRESH. tape_leg_min_bars/tape_leg_min_move_pct: a dump leg = a run of >= min_bars consecutive longs_closing bars with net move <= -min_move_pct; tape_min_legs of those = rotation evidence. onchain_*: fresh-wallet fingerprint (young nonce), count and size gates for the fresh-wallet->CEX leg; onchain_max_channels bounds the provider reads. board_max_age_h: persisted verdict older than this is stale and not echoed on the board.
